mentions.name: All The Places
mentions.description: Open source scraping project with about 4,700 scrapers extracting over 40 million points of interest — shop locations, postal addresses, restaurants, schools, weather stations, marine buoys, traffic cameras, street trees, and more — for use in OpenStreetMap and other projects. A contributor community keeps the scrapers maintained and expands coverage; potential downstream uses include weekly location maps of restaurant chains and time-series charts of retail chain growth uploaded to Wikimedia Commons.
mentions.problem: The location data scraped by the project is heavily underutilized in other open source/community projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: Contributor for an open source scraper -- https://alltheplaces.xyz/ -- which currently has about 4700 scrapers extracting 40-someting million points of interest.
